title.zh: 加密货币交易所Bitget遭3.5亿美元黑客攻击后暂停提款 - The American Bazaar
title.en: Crypto exchange Bitget pauses withdrawals after $350 million hack - The American Bazaar

current_state.zh: Bitget 在 9 月 24 日安全事件后已部分恢复提现，先恢复 BTC，ETH 和 USDT 提现计划稍后恢复；被盗金额修正为 3.875 亿美元，攻击者继续通过 THORChain 转移资金。
current_state.en: Bitget has partially restored withdrawals after the Sept. 24 security incident, starting with BTC, with ETH and USDT planned next; the stolen amount was revised to $387.5M and the attacker continues moving funds via THORChain.

updates.what_changed_zh: Bitget在遭遇3.5亿美元黑客攻击后暂停提款，事件处理期间用户无法将资金转出交易所。
updates.what_changed_en: Bitget halted withdrawals after suffering a $350 million hack, leaving users unable to move funds off the exchange while the incident is contained.

updates.title_zh: 黑客通过THORChain兑换ETH，Bitget恢复比特币提款
updates.title_en: Bitget resumes Bitcoin withdrawals as hacker swaps ETH via THORChain
updates.what_changed_zh: Bitget 已恢复比特币网络和 BNB Smart Chain 上的 BTC 提现，将被盗金额从 3.516 亿美元修正为 3.875 亿美元，攻击者正通过 THORChain 将 ETH 兑换为 BTC，ETH 和 USDT 提现计划随后恢复。
updates.what_changed_en: Bitget resumed BTC withdrawals on Bitcoin and BNB Smart Chain, revised the stolen amount from $351.6M to $387.5M, and the attacker is swapping ETH via THORChain; ETH and USDT withdrawals are scheduled to resume next.
updates.current_state_zh: Bitget 在 9 月 24 日安全事件后已部分恢复提现，先恢复 BTC，ETH 和 USDT 提现计划稍后恢复；被盗金额修正为 3.875 亿美元，攻击者继续通过 THORChain 转移资金。
updates.current_state_en: Bitget has partially restored withdrawals after the Sept. 24 security incident, starting with BTC, with ETH and USDT planned next; the stolen amount was revised to $387.5M and the attacker continues moving funds via THORChain.
updates.detailed_summary_zh: Bitget resumed Bitcoin withdrawals on the Bitcoin and BNB Smart Chain networks after last week's $387.5M hot/warm wallet breach, with Ether and USDT withdrawals slated to follow, while the attacker continues swapping stolen ETH through THORChain.
updates.detailed_summary_en: Bitget resumed Bitcoin withdrawals on the Bitcoin and BNB Smart Chain networks after last week's $387.5M hot/warm wallet breach, with Ether and USDT withdrawals slated to follow, while the attacker continues swapping stolen ETH through THORChain.
